source_evidence.text: I will bring forward the pilot only after the subcontractor amendment is signed.

It will include a half-time coordinator for six months, a limited transport-readiness checklist that does not replace clinical judgment, arrival confirmation, patient and staff refusal, immediate fallback, and reporting that places capacity beside—not above—the complete journey.
We will review who never reaches the request stage as well as failed rides.
Any continuation will need a separate staffing and privacy decision; the contract will not renew automatically.
